scope: allocation analytics; not a settlement restatement
limitations: Assumption-based diagnostic; not a new production charge or a certified global debt reconciliation.
Potential Savings dependencies propagate conservatively across mixed transactions, not quantified Savings balances.
Refinancing Savings and debt repayments need separate attribution; original capital is not outstanding ilk debt.
Uses normalized history through 2026-09-30 and published 2026-09 revenue/rates; no revenue regeneration.
Costs reuse the existing daily effective blended rate and exact available dollar deductions.
Deductions are capped at allocation principal for its charge; excess deduction credit remains explicitly separate for the global bridge.
capital_method: Original capital carried through normalized transactions, weighted-average source basis; end-of-day convention.
funding_policy: Operator-confirmed Sky funding except Spark Savings; exclude classified income and reinvested gains.
net_definition: Prime-retained venue revenue minus modeled allocation borrowing costs; excludes Prime-level adjustments/spread reimbursements.
